BLOCKED on an external fixture source. Conformance requires expected values from the Python multimatch_gaze package, which is not installed here (numpy is). I have not installed it, since that changes the user's Python environment.

To unblock: 'pip install multimatch-gaze', then I generate fixtures under tools/multimatch-parity/ and add the conformance test. The comparison must use grouping=FALSE, since eyes4s does not implement scanpath simplification (see MultiMatch scaladoc) and neither does eyesim's R implementation.

Note what IS already verified without it: the monotone-lattice DP agrees with brute-force enumeration over every monotone path, so the alignment -- the part eyesim delegates to igraph Dijkstra -- is exact. What remains unverified is the five dimension summaries against the reference.
